details:
Since it’s on my mind I’d like to suggest something. This mainly goes out to the content creators like me that utilize the camera in more dynamic ways then you would normally use on a day to day basis, hence what makes it unique. So here it is:
Be able to place a “track” for your camera to follow. When you then press play, your camera follows said track without having you move it. This helps create camera movements and allows for amazing cinematography. Implementation of this will allow more people to be creative with their filming process in VRChat.
Another feature I would love to suggest is freezing avatar in place and/or creating animations you can leave in the world for the purpose of cinematography. What I mean by this is by the press of a button you can put a frozen version of your avatar in a world so can either have multiple of you or multiple of your personal avatars for once again the purpose of cinematics. 
Anyways thank you for reading my suggestion and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
title: More Dynamic Camera Movement and Freezing Avatars in Place
